title: IH-THREAD-ROSEWOOD-PLAN-SET-REGISTRATION-V1
retrievalQuestions: How should a canonical drawing set be registered before extraction?
What gates prove a plan set and page index are ready?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: A new project drawing PDF has been ingested.
startAt: Confirm project ID, document ID, source hash, cover sheet, and index authority.
runPreflight: Search for existing active plan-set and sheet-index records before creating new ones.
doNot: Do not infer missing owner or drawing project number.
Do not begin takeoff before index completeness passes.
Do not store the whole plan index only as an opaque JSON blob.
proveBeforeClaiming: Every PDF page is accounted for.
Cover and index authorities are linked.
